statement: The fourth Grand Frogger was released on May 11 2022 for World 1 party dungeons and they went for a day one kill.
Recycle RNG vouchers dropped off the gecko and other early enemies and use them to spam RNG for items.
Sell junk items like rabbit's paw and lump dice during the run while keeping useful ones such as the ninja smoke and three of a kind.
With time running out and few sausages left he just spams RNG with vouchers rather than making sausages.
You need a ton of boss calls to progress toward the boss during the run.
He has so much armadillo that it hurts and the run looks much better than the previous one.
Roll weapons for increased damage and enhance for about 15 more total damage but DPS is still not enough.
Doing about 9000 damage; if he gets the full item in right now they win but time is short.
He only has 12 RNG vouchers and says there is no shot at the pressure and the lack of vouchers.
The clear came down to the wire with roughly two minutes left then massive damage landed and they won the fight.
He achieved a hornless run on the new frog boss and is excited about it.
A hornless run only needs nine RNG vouchers according to him.
He cites his damage and his crit drop rate at 2.65 as being easy.
